text:
alex nguyen: Quick async check-in — landed a small docs patch for the Node quickstart (`require` -> `import`). PR #342, @samir please take a look when you have a minute. CI is green locally but mac wheel job flaked earlier.

maria gonzalez: Thanks alex! I'm free to review after lunch. I ran the sample app locally and hit a runtime error with the example env var names — pushing a commit to standardize to `REDWOOD_API_KEY`.

samir patel: On it. I'll skim the PR now. FWIW I saw a flaky test in sampleapp e2e last night — probably timeout on the startup script. Filed #789 to increase wait and added a tiny retry wrapper.

jen kim: What I did: refreshed the Python quickstart docs and added a note about quantization profiles. Blocker: waiting on a short answer from infra about example deployment region (should we use `us-west-2` or `eu-west-1` in the sample?).

tim obrien: prefer `us-west-2` for now (lower latency for most testers) — but add a short callout to switch for EU customers. Also, I updated the sampleapp README with a one-line troubleshoot for `CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES`.

alex nguyen: @maria great — appreciate the env var fix. @jen we'll default to `us-west-2` and add the region note.

samir patel: Reviewed PR #342 — left one nit about the import path in the TypeScript snippet and a suggestion to add a code block example for streaming. LGTM after that.

alex nguyen: thanks! pushing an amend now.

ci-bot: Build started for branch `docs/quickstart-node-fix` (PR #342) — status: queued

maria gonzalez: Small FYI: I found two tiny typos in the CLI reference; I'll open a separate PR so this one stays focused.

jen kim: Blocker cleared — infra confirmed region guidance in the #infra channel. I'll update the quickstart and open a PR for the Python doc changes by EOD.

tim obrien: Quick note — can we add a single end-to-end smoke test step in the sampleapp CI that runs `npm run smoke` for 30s? That would have caught the startup flake. Happy to add it in a follow-up.

alex nguyen: yes please — add as a follow-up. For today: I'll finish the amend and then smoke the sampleapp on M1, post results here. If anything blocks, I'll ping @samir. :thumbsup:

samir patel: ping back if CI still flakes; I can rerun the mac job manually.

alex nguyen: Update: amended and force-pushed, CI requeued. Will report back with final green/red.

ci-bot: Build updated for PR #342 — status: running

maria gonzalez: tiny reminder — after PRs merge can we publish a patch release for the docs site? We should bump the docs-only changelog so external users see the fixes.

alex nguyen: noted — I'll prep the changelog entry after merges.

jen kim: OK, signing off for now. Good momentum today.

samir patel: thanks all — will review any follow-ups.

alex nguyen: last: if anyone wants to pair later to validate the sampleapp on M1, I'll be at my desk 4–5pm PST.

ci-bot: PR #342 merged (docs/quickstart-node-fix) — congrats! :tada:
